one_line_summary: Guided by the true piecewise-polynomial hint, the run climbed the entire ladder to the full inclusion-exclusion truncated-power formula over all plus-leg subsets and verified it to exact rational equality across many chambers, n=4-7, g-scaling, and the degenerate n=4 boundary; it did not diverge, though it candidly leaned on the hint's polynomiality promise rather than independently re-deriving it.
